_note: Decode-level hallucination controls passed DIRECTLY to the Whisper model at inference (faster-whisper / transformers). Tighten these to suppress hallucinations at the source instead of only post-filtering.

_hints.log_prob_threshold: Raise toward 0 (e.g. -0.5) to DROP more low-confidence (hallucinated) segments.
_hints.no_speech_threshold: Lower (e.g. 0.4) to treat more audio as no-speech and skip it.
_hints.compression_ratio_threshold: Lower (e.g. 2.0) to catch more repetitive hallucinations.
_hints.condition_on_previous_text: false stops hallucinations from propagating across chunks.
_hints.hallucination_silence_threshold: faster-whisper: skip silence longer than this (s) when a hallucination is suspected.
